items.description: Remove obsolete complete-state acceptance from commit, triage, and resolve.
items.evidence: .agents/skills/{commit,triage,resolve}/SKILL.md lifecycle.accepts each still includes complete although their workflows now require approved, review-findings, or triaged active targets and reject archived records.
items.analysis: The old acceptances advertised the archival completion-feedback route that this change removes. Leaving them permits invalid lifecycle dispatches and contradicts the active-only rules in the same skills.
items.recommendation: Remove complete from the lifecycle accepts lists in installed and blueprint copies, and add focused metadata coverage so no retired workflow route remains declared.
items.rationale: Accepted: the retired archival-feedback routes must not remain declared after the workflow that used them is removed.
